evidence.note: was: Work out the extra tax you'll actually owe on a bonus or commission payment for the year. See the marginal tax rate applied to your lump sum and your actual take-home bonus.

decisions.proposedLead: Tax on a bonus in Australia is the difference between the annual tax on salary alone and the annual tax on salary plus bonus, worked out on the 2026-27 scale; there is no flat bonus tax. For an employee on $90,000 receiving $10,000, that difference is $3,200, so $6,800 of the bonus is kept [[bonusTaxSplit]]. Employers withhold from bonus payments using ATO Schedule 5, and any over-withholding is refunded at tax time.

On a $30 base, 3 hours at time-and-a-half is $135. Rates current from 1 July 2026.

decisions.proposedLead: The zone tax offset is a non-refundable tax offset for Australian residents whose usual home is in a remote area (Zone A or Zone B) for 183 days or more in an income year [[ZONE_QUALIFYING_DAYS]]. For 2025-26 the fixed amount is $338 in Zone A, $57 in Zone B and $1,173 in a special area [[ZONE_AREA_RATES]], plus 50% (Zone A) or 20% (Zone B) of any dependant base amount, claimed at question T4.

decisions.proposedLead: An estimated tax return is the difference between the PAYG tax withheld from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the tax owed on the 2025-26 scale: $18,200 tax-free, then 16% to $45,000 and 30% to $135,000 [[TAX_BRACKETS_2025_26]], plus the 2% Medicare levy. More withheld than owed is a refund; less is a bill. The return is due 31 October 2026 if self-lodged, or 15 May 2027 through most tax agents [[RETURN_2026]].
